ns2:section.sectionText: Meets first 8 weeks. (1hour credit) S/U graded credit. Designed to let first year students majoring or interested in Astronomy meet faculty in a small group setting in the Astronomy Department or at a faculty member's home. Students should assemble on Wednesdays at 6:25 p.m. in 134 Astronomy building. When meetings are at a faculty member's home, transportation will be provided between the Astronomy building and the home. Students may not register for both DS1 and DS2 when both sections are being offered. First Year Discovery Program Course. Registration restricted to freshman. Students should enroll in only one Discovery course. Students who enroll in more than one Discovery course may be dropped from the additional Discovery courses. For course descriptions, see the Discovery Program booklet.
